title: Willow Dormitory
shortDescription: Willow shadows lace a quiet room of green quilts.
longDescription:
Willow branches comb the window glass, drawing moving lines across neatly folded green quilts. A low table holds a repaired lantern, a bowl of smooth river stones, and a stack of letters waiting for imaginary adventures.
Beside the window, a dream mobile turns in the draught. Its paper stars make almost no sound.

fixtures.name: Dream Mobile
fixtures.examineDescription: Each folded star carries a small hope: 'Learn one brave thing.' 'Make room at the table.' 'Find out where the moon goes in puddles.' The lowest star has been left blank. You turn it gently and watch the whole constellation find its balance.
